Analytics & CRO

Know what is working, and fix what is not.

Tracking, analytics, funnel analysis and conversion rate optimisation so decisions rest on evidence.

Book a Strategy Call →View Pricing →

The problem

Dashboards disagree, conversions are not tracked, or tracking was installed once and never checked. Decisions get made on opinion, and traffic that should convert quietly leaks away at the same points.

Our solution

We agree what matters, implement tracking correctly with respect for consent, and build reporting people actually read. Funnel analysis shows where visitors drop out, and structured experiments test improvements where traffic is sufficient.

Our process

  1. Measurement plan

    Goals, events, definitions and what each report is for.

  2. Implementation

    GA4, Google Tag Manager and platform tags set up and verified.

  3. Consent-aware configuration

    Tracking aligned to your cookie and privacy practices.

  4. Reporting

    Dashboards for owners and for day-to-day teams.

  5. Funnel analysis

    Where visitors drop out and why it may be happening.

  6. Testing

    Prioritised hypotheses tested and documented.

Deliverables

  • Measurement plan
  • GA4 and Tag Manager set-up
  • Event and conversion tracking
  • Consent-aware tracking configuration
  • Reporting dashboards
  • Funnel analysis and findings
  • CRO test backlog and experiments
  • Recommendations

Ideal customer

  • Sites with traffic that does not convert as hoped
  • Businesses running paid media without trustworthy conversion data
  • E-commerce stores looking for checkout and product-page improvements

A note on results

We do not guarantee specific results. Outcomes depend on your market, offer, budget and competition. We agree measures and targets with you, report honestly and recommend what to do next.
